title: Glassy
body:
[✨] Glassy is a modpack designed as an alternative to OptiFine. It includes most of OptiFine's features: built-in shader support, significant improvements in rendering and logic performance, extra features for resource packs to utilize, a zoom feature and much more.

[💎] The pack also includes a number of additional features. Want to add your own mods that aren't included in Glassy? You can easily do so after installation.
